macros.name: SBLPageWithNote
macros.doc: Output page with note number using n. or nn. depending on how many notes there are.

macros.name: SBLPrintIndices
macros.doc: This command prints one or more indices depending on which are enabled with the ancient sources, modern authors and subject options.

macros.name: SBLSetMaxRomanPage
macros.doc: Set the maximum Roman page number (as an integer, not in Roman format) in the document in case automatic detection fails.

macros.name: see
